private boolean isFeatureDeclared(Document document, String featureName) {
    NodeList list = document.getElementsByTagName("uses-feature");
    for (int i=0; i<list.getLength(); i++) {
        Element feature = (Element) list.item(i);
        if (featureName.equals(feature.getAttributeNS(ANDROID_URI, "name"))) {
            String required = feature.getAttributeNS(ANDROID_URI, "required");
            if ("false".equals(required)) {
                return true;
            }
        }
    }
    return false;
}
